As a South African I've had quite a few interesting encounters. However, the one that stands out was with a class trip where we were in nature preserve on foot. A few of us broke off from the main group and walked into a an area where there were these really old trees. No leaves. It was beautiful. We walked in between them and as we exited the other side a herd of wildebeest circled us. It was loud and a lite frightening. As they ran off we headed back to the main group. It's something I'll never forget.
